# Introduction

Type 2 diabetes has a strong genetic component[^heritability].
A polygenic score adds the effects of many variants into one number for each person.

::: {.column-margin}
The score uses 400 variants from published studies.
:::

[^heritability]: Twin studies put the heritability between 30 and 70 per cent.

# Methods

The cohort follows 5000 adults from the north of France.
Each adult has a genotype and a measure of fasting glucose every two years.

# Results

Adults in the top tenth of the score have three times the risk of those in the bottom tenth.
